script: Before you buy anything, understand what matters. The most important number is graphics memory, called V RAM. An AI model must fit there to run fast. System RAM is a slower backup. A seven-billion-parameter model, compressed to four bits, needs about four and a half gigabytes. Check that number before you choose any model.
